name: The majority voted in favour of government [amendments (1) and (2) on sheet FR102](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7275_amend_a20921b1-60c5-4c5f-ae31-34dfae97ceb7%22;rec=0), which means it succeeded and will now become a part of the bill. ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 1, item 1, page 13 (line 9), before “Matters”, insert “(1)”.* > > *(2) Schedule 1, item 1, page 13 (after line 16), at the end of section 58BB, add:* > >> *(2) In determining whether a regulated entity has taken reasonable steps for the purposes of a provision of this Division, the primary consideration must be the matter in paragraph (1)(e) (if applicable).*
